WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    mlp.product_name,
    mlp.brand,
    mlp.model,
    mlp.price_eur,
    mlp.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN max_dt
WHERE mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.last_seen = max_dt.max_date
ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    v.product_name,
    v.brand,
    v.model,
    v.drop_date,
    v.prev_price,
    v.new_price,
    v.drop_eur,
    v.drop_pct,
    v.skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops v
CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE v.category = 'laptop'
  AND v.drop_date >= l.max_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY v.drop_pct ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS dropped_products_count
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS new_products_count
FROM products
WHERE first_seen >= (SELECT max(date) FROM price_snapshots) - interval '7 days'
LIMIT 50

FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.last_seen = ld.dt
LIMIT 50

FROM products

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_eur) AS median_price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'tablet'
  AND brand = 'Apple'
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    model,
    price_eur,
    skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices, latest_date
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND product_name ILIKE '%iPhone 15%'
  AND last_seen = latest_date.max_date
ORDER BY price_eur ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH cheapest_s24 AS (
    SELECT
        mlp.id,
        mlp.product_name,
        mlp.brand,
        mlp.price_eur AS latest_price
    FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
    WHERE mlp.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%'
      AND mlp.category = 'phone'
    ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    cs.product_name,
    cs.brand,
    cs.latest_price,
    mpf.all_time_low AS lowest_price_ever
FROM cheapest_s24 cs
JOIN mv_price_floor mpf ON mpf.product_id = cs.id
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT max(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
cheapest AS (
    SELECT id, product_name, brand, model
    FROM mv_latest_prices
    WHERE category = 'phone'
      AND brand ILIKE 'samsung'
      AND (model ILIKE '%s24%' OR product_name ILIKE '%galaxy s24%')
    ORDER BY price_eur ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.product_name,
    c.brand,
    c.model,
    ps.date,
    ps.price_eur,
    ps.rating,
    ps.reviews
FROM price_snapshots ps
JOIN cheapest c ON ps.product_id = c.id
CROSS JOIN max_dt m
WHERE ps.date BETWEEN m.max_date - INTERVAL '6 days' AND m.max_date
ORDER BY ps.date
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS smartwatch_count
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE mlp.category = 'smartwatch'
  AND mlp.price_eur < 50
  AND mlp.last_seen = ld.max_date
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    rating,
    reviews,
    price_eur,
    skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND reviews > 50
ORDER BY rating DESC, reviews DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS falling_products_count
FROM mv_price_trend_direction
WHERE trend = 'falling'
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT max(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT date, avg_price
    FROM mv_daily_market_index, max_dt
    WHERE category = 'tablet'
      AND date BETWEEN max_dt.max_date - interval '1 month' AND max_dt.max_date
)
SELECT date AS day, avg_price
FROM filtered
WHERE date = (SELECT min(date) FROM filtered)
   OR date = (SELECT max(date) FROM filtered)
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS phone_count
FROM products, max_dt
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND ram_gb = 16
  AND last_seen = max_dt.max_date
LIMIT 50

SELECT 'NO_DATA' AS no_data WHERE false
LIMIT 50
